'''The Blue Rose''' is an inn located in the [[Kandor]]i city of [[Canluum]]. In {{ne|979}}, its proprietor was one [[Racelle Arovni]].

The Blue Rose was an old haunt of the [[Malkier]]i warrior [[Bukama Marenellin]], who was on intimate terms with its innkeeper. Bukama and [[al'Lan Mandragoran]] stayed at the Blue Rose on their way to [[Chachin]] and were attacked by [[Darkfriends]] there.{{ref/book|0|16}}
